lines.en: I trot low along the ground.
My claws leave marks in the ground.

lines.zh: 我拐着弯靠近，不走直线
lines.en: I come at an angle, never straight.
Flame rises off my shoulders.
I skip along, avoiding the light.
I slip behind the rocks.
I drag my shadow along with me.
I know this path by touch.

lines.zh: 我的脚步几乎没有声音
lines.en: My steps make almost no sound.
I creep toward where you are.
I stop, then go on.
I slide along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我缩在阴影里，一动不动
lines.en: I huddle in shadow without moving.
My flames flicker slowly.
I'm listening to your breathing.
My claws scrape the ground softly.
I crouch in the shade, grinding my teeth.
I hiss, low.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，几乎贴地
lines.en: I flatten myself nearly to the floor.
The fireball I throw runs green.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我抬了抬头
lines.en: Something moved; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后慢慢甩
lines.en: My tail swings slowly behind me.
I don't like this place.
A fireball rolls in my palm.
Fire burns on me, and it doesn't hurt.
I lick argent off my claws.
The smells here are muddled.
I'll stay quiet and let you come.
I see you. Don't pretend.
I tilt my head, eyes bright.
Your shadow moved before you did.
My tail brushes your boot.
Your sleeve smells of gunpowder.
Your heartbeat reaches the ground.
Want to run? I'm good at chasing.
I raise my head and grin.
You're more nervous than the last one.
I've marked where you stand.
This darkness is mine.
Don't let your hands shake; you'll miss.
I back off two steps and return.
Put away that measuring look.
You have a weak point about you.
I'm fast. Try me.

lines.zh: 这么近，我能数你的睫毛
lines.en: This close, I can count your lashes.
My laugh comes out sharp.
I hiss and pull back.
That knocked me askew.
My flames dimmed for an instant.
My claws gouge the ground.
Blood drips on hot stone and smokes.
I curl once, then straighten.
Even this body feels pain.
One of my claws was smashed off.
I retreat into the shadow.
Don't think that's the end.
What's that? Still steaming.
I lean in, nose first.
I'm not picky. Anything that burns.
Set it down and I'll take it.
This smell is too faint.
I sniff first, then decide.
Don't pull your hand back. I won't bite.
I lick it — hot.
More of that. This isn't enough.
I take it and turn away to eat.
One twist and I'm clear.
You bump me and I'm knocked aside.
I dart between your legs.
Tight spots are a nuisance.
I slide along your leg.

lines.zh: 一碰就退，这是我的习惯
lines.en: Touch and retreat. That's my habit.

lines.zh: 我的爪子里还留着亚金能源。
lines.en: Argent Energy still clings to my claws.
I can slip free quickly.
A little jostling doesn't hinder me.
Don't come too close. I bite.
Among my kind, we only fight over ground.
I don't need a companion.
To come close, you go through me first.
Only I stay in this darkness.
I've seen plenty of your kind.
I leave no one alive.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，也许我改主意
lines.en: Stand still. Maybe I'll change my mind.
Don't expect tenderness.
I only know fire and blood.
If you go, don't come back.
I lift it between my claw tips.
I turn it over in my claws.
I could burn this.
Too small to hold.

lines.zh: 我一把抓起来，塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I grab it and stuff it in my mouth.
I hide it under a stone.
What's on the ground is mine.
It's mine now. Don't ask.
Too light. I toss it away.
No use for this.
I smell something alive.
Argent fire runs in my veins.
The firelight on you is obvious.
I'm judging your distance to the wall.
I flex my claws in.
Shadow falls on me. Perfect.
I crouch low, ready.
You haven't noticed yet.
My paws snuff out the sparks.
Only you and I in this patch.
I'll come from the right.
Firelight wavers in my eyes.
Now you're mine.
No shout. I just pounce.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就从火里冲出来。
lines.en: Count to three and I burst out of the fire.
That's two.
I circle, waiting for you to strike.
Can your eyes keep up with me?
I'm at your rear flank.
You turn; I turn.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，随时能扑上去
lines.en: Crouched, I can spring at any moment.
The ground slides under my claws.
Your breathing's ragged. Good.
I'm against the wall now.
I count your footsteps.
You've backed to the rocks.
I'm coming from above.
My flames leap higher.
You've no room left.
This time I'll connect.
Let's see how fast you are.
I laugh, very softly.
Three, two.
Fire under my feet — I don't need to walk
You're finished.
Don't close your eyes.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先碰到你的腿。
lines.en: My claws find your leg first.
My teeth sank into your leg.
I rake once and pull back.
Fire spews from my mouth.
I slam in from the side.
My tail lashes its face.
It retreats; I follow.
I leap onto its back.
That claw opened its hide.
It makes an ugly sound.
I bite and hold.
Fire catches on it.
I let go and spring aside.
Not finished yet.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子准备第二次
lines.en: I crouch for a second round.
It's starting to fear.
That blow went wide.
I add another claw strike.
I crawl out of the fire.
The air turns hot at once.
I shake off the sparks.
My eyes open first.
It's brighter here than I expected.
My horns push up through the ash.
All the smells here are new.
I dig my claws into the ground.
Flame kindles on my shoulders.
I hear something breathing.
I crouch low and slip into shadow.
I remember what I'm called.
This world will burn.
First, I find a dark path.
I watch from behind the stones.
Someone's coming.
I grin, and the fire grows.
Let's begin.
This fire burns hotter than mine.
I fall from a height and my legs buckle.
Water smothers my flames.
The blast throws me against the wall.
An arrow pins me to the ground.
This power holds me still.
My fire is dying. I need to eat.
Lightning hits me and I spasm.
I fall into the dark, and my fire goes out.
